name: DianSheng Googol 3x3 (14.8cm)
description: The DianSheng Googol 3x3 (14.8cm) is a massive, oversized cube built for fun, display, or casual solves. Despite its size, it turns surprisingly well and keeps the same layout as a standard 3x3. It’s available in both vibrant stickerless and soft pastel stickerless color schemes, giving you a choice of bold or subtle aesthetics.
